acceptance: The model-probe picker capture's tmux session registry is written where the crash-orphan reaper actually sweeps (per sessionrecord.PathIn's own doc: reap-discoverable only under .evolve/runs/cycle-<N>/), OR the probe path is explicitly excluded from registry-based reaping with a reasoned comment and the orphan-socket GC covers it.
A probe process killed mid-/model-capture leaves no unreaped tmux session after the next GC sweep (regression test or live-verified).
go vet ./..., -race green on touched packages.
connects_to: adversarial round-2 review of feat/model-latest-selection (footnote: pre-existing, NOT introduced by the scratch-workspace change — Workspace was projectRoot before, equally non-cycle-shaped)
tmux_session_gc shipped infra (the sweep this registry is supposed to feed)
fix: Route the picker-capture path's sessionrecord to a reap-discoverable location (a live registry must be visible to a CONCURRENT reaper — archiving after exit is useless, so this is a write-target fix, not a salvage-on-teardown fix), or document + wire the probe's tmux sessions into the orphan-socket GC that already runs at cycle start.
problem: bridgeModelCapturer's recipe path writes the tmux crash-recovery session registry via sessionrecord.Append(PathIn(cfg.Workspace)) — but the probe's Workspace has never been a cycle-<N> path (projectRoot before 2026-08-05, scratch temp dir after), and the registry's own contract says it is only reap-discoverable under .evolve/runs/cycle-<N>/. A probe crashed mid-capture therefore leaves a tmux session the registry-based reaper never finds (the cycle-start orphan-socket GC is the only net). Pre-existing gap, surfaced by the round-2 adversarial review of the model-latest branch.
title: Model-probe tmux session registry is written where no reaper looks
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: It leaks at most an idle REPL session, only when an operator-run probe crashes, and a manual gc already clears it; what remains is the useless registry write plus a pin test.
review_status: inbox review 2026-09-27: PARTIAL. The probe still appends its registry to a scratch workspace (recipe_adapter.go:69 via cmd_models_live.go:248). Its session name carries -pid<N> (tmux_session.go:39) and the evolve-recipe- namespace is in the orphan GC (swarm/reap_orphans.go:14). However, the loop's per-cycle gcOrphanSessions (cmd_loop_control.go:338-345) lists only its own per-run socket (EVOLVE_TMUX_SOCKET=evolve-bridge-p<pid>, cmd_loop_runtime.go:31). `evolve models refresh` (cmd_models.go:102) runs on the shared evolve-bridge
